QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] New Power (4th Job Advancement)
QuestInfo.0: Preparations for the next phase of training are complete. Talk to Eremos.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos said you must complete the 4th Job Advancement before continuing your training. Talk to Eremos when you've done so.
QuestInfo.2: You obtained a new power with your 4th Job Advancement. Eremos gave you equipment to help with your training as a celebratory gift!
